gap: No result ChatGPT got states what its three named picks cost or weigh today. At keychron.com on 2026-11-08 the full-height Keychron Q1 Max is $209.99 and 1,724 g. The low-profile Keychron K3 Max is $89.99 and 525 g, has the same 75% layout and the same 2.4 GHz/Bluetooth/wired modes, and Keychron rates its battery at 73 hours against the Q1 Max's 180. Keychron's own K3 Ultra 8K is $109.99 and rated at up to 550 hours.
standout_why: ChatGPT ran no web search in either saved chat, so it had no rival pages to compare against. Its answer named the NuPhy Air75 V2, Keychron K3 Max and Keychron Q1 Max with no prices, weights or battery figures. Its comparison table only said 'Portability: Better / Bulkier' and 'May benefit from a wrist rest'. A side-by-side of today's maker prices, weights, battery ratings and front height for each model is new to this question.
decides: This backs the low-profile pick for most shoppers on price and portability. For the same 75% wireless layout, the full-height Q1 Max costs $120 more ($209.99 vs $89.99) and is about 3.3× heavier (1,724 g vs 525 g). KitGuru lists its front height as 22.6 mm without keycaps, which is why a wrist rest comes up. Within low-profile, the K3 Max is not the clear pick. For $20 more, the K3 Ultra 8K ($109.99) is rated at up to 550 hours on battery against the K3 Max's 73. Our Lofree Flow Lite 2 84 is $109, and the aluminum Lofree Flow 2 84 is $159.
